verdict.rationale: SavvyCal is a scheduling SaaS with no agent or AI-assistant component in the evidence, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools does not fit its product role. The evidence does mention MCP (docs-65), but it describes the opposite role: external MCP clients such as Claude or Cursor connecting to SavvyCal. That is server-side capability and does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
